issue.title: Web article extraction drops the language-mermaid class, so saved web sources catalog Mermaid diagrams as plain code

task_type_fields.impact: Web-article references (bob-cli-d3 saved sources) catalog Mermaid diagrams as ordinary code, so `bob ref code` and the Bob Mac Capture Copy card C picker label them as code with no language, and the saved `source.md` loses the ```mermaid fence. Copying still works; only the diagram classification and language marker are lost.
task_type_fields.location: scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py (Defuddle 0.19.4 extraction in run_capture, before sanitize_html)
task_type_fields.repro:
Reported by epic phase bob-cli-d3.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, 2026-10-27) while adding saved web-article sources; recorded by the bob-cli-d3 land agent, not independently reproduced by it. Root cause: the web-clip adapter extracts articles with Defuddle 0.19.4 (`DEFUDDLE_VERSION` in `scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py`), whose code-block standardization drops the `language-mermaid` class from `
`. bob-cli-d3.1 widened the nh3 sanitizer allowlist so `pre`/`code` keep `class`, and the self-test proves the sanitizer alone keeps `language-mermaid`, but the class is already gone by the time the sanitizer sees Defuddle's output.

Repro: capture an article whose body has a `
graph TD ...
` block (for example `bob ref create  -H scripts/web_clip/fixtures/article_basic.html -k` with `BOB_WEB_CLIP_KEEP_WORKDIR=1`). Inspect `render/source.html` and the saved `.bob/ref-sources/blogs/--/source.md` + `code.json`: the Mermaid block is a plain fence with no `mermaid` info string, so `code.json` records it as an ordinary code block (`lang` null) instead of `kind: "mermaid"`.

Likely fix: tag each `pre`/`code` language class in a `data-` attribute before Defuddle runs and restore it after extraction (or post-process Defuddle's output), then extend `--self-test` so the real capture path (not just `sanitize_html`) keeps `language-mermaid`.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by epic phase bob-cli-d3.1 while adding saved web-article sources; the Defuddle step upstream of the epic's sanitizer change loses the Mermaid marker, which is outside that epic's scope.
